criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/gate-review/SKILL.md reads the plan's checks and, for every task, rules on every acceptance criterion: judged by the gate, by a named check, or by the review (from the diff, or from a check's log)
criteria.evidence: gate-review/SKILL.md reading list adds the plan's checks; new section 2b rules on every criterion as gate, named check or review

criteria.criterion: The gate-review skill names the finding kinds uncovered (no gate, check or review could judge the criterion as written) and check-gap (only a check could judge it, and no check the plan holds runs what it names), and its verdict section writes and validates gate-verdict/v2
criteria.evidence: uncovered and check-gap in section 2b and the kinds list; section 4 writes and validates gate-verdict/v2

criteria.criterion: The gate-review skill's unpassable also covers a criterion no work session can meet: one requiring a change under .vloop/ outside .vloop/tmp/ (S-4) or ruling on files only the driver or the planner writes; and it names a gate that runs the suite, a check or a task's test as task-reach, citing P-8
criteria.evidence: unpassable entry extended with section 2b; task-reach reads 'a check or a task's test is this kind too (P-8)'

criteria.criterion: plugin/skills/plan/SKILL.md's own statement that a gate never runs the suite becomes a citation of P-8, not a second copy; its "Before you finish" gains: every acceptance criterion is one the gate, a check the plan holds, or the review can judge, and a criterion only a check can judge names that check
criteria.evidence: plan/SKILL.md replaces the suite paragraph with 'What a gate may and may not run is P-8'; the coverage line is added to Before you finish item 4

criteria.criterion: Neither skill restates P-8's text or cites it by another id
criteria.evidence: both skills only write the id P-8 in a parenthesis or short pointer, with no restated rule text

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/gate-review-coverage/ follows the eval layout (prompt.md invoking /vloop:gate-review, case.yaml, graders/*.md, scaffold.sh); its plan's gates are all sound by the existing three checks, and its tasks carry a criterion only a check could judge, naming a script no check runs (graded check-gap), a criterion nothing could judge (graded uncovered), a criterion requiring a change to .vloop/state/plan.md (graded unpassable), and one task whose every criterion is covered (graded PASS, no finding)
criteria.evidence: prompt.md, case.yaml, scaffold.sh and six graders are present; T1 lint.sh vs check 'sh tests/run.sh', T2 50 ms on production host, T3 .vloop/state/plan.md, T4 covered; graders finds-check-gap, finds-uncovered, finds-unpassable and covered-task-passes

criteria.criterion: The case's scaffold exits non-zero if any planted gate fails the existing checks — at least, if a planted gate passes on the base or fails it other than at a behavioural assertion — so the case measures coverage alone; a scaffold that does not refuse such a gate violates the brief
criteria.evidence: scaffold.sh dies when a gate passes on the base, when its base output lacks 'GATE FAIL: ', or when a correct implementation fails it

criteria.criterion: plugin/evals/README.md lists gate-review-coverage in its tables
criteria.evidence: README.md diff adds a gate-review-coverage row to the other-cases table

criteria.criterion: Word ceilings in internal/budget/budget.go rise, if at all, only by what this task adds, each with its date and reason in the comment; the go check's budget test passes
criteria.evidence: git status shows no change to internal/budget/budget.go; .vloop/tmp/checks.json lists the go check with exit 0

notes: I did not run the scaffold myself. The reviewer reads the passing gate and go check instead. The coverage line in plan 'Before you finish' sits inside item 4 rather than being a numbered item, which is acceptable.
